Messages.Author: AaronC
Messages.Body:
I didn't realize that VEKN was still maintaining the WW ranking system.

Is it supposed to be valid? For instance, I am not in the list, and I have attended at least 12 tournaments in the past 18 months, including the 2012 NAC, and won four.

It's also missing the names of several other Americans I know from the West Coast, some of who have also won tournaments. The list of Americans seems to contain the same names as the rating systems maintained by WW before it closed, including the names of some people who obviously haven't attended any events for a very, very long time.

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
> AaronC wrote:
> Is it supposed to be valid?
>
I think this depends on two factors:

1) How diligent the tournament coordinators are at submitting their results.
2) How much the national coordinator cares to follow-up.

For example, Finland is great at submitting their results and Lonkka follows-up with them regularly. The United States is at the other end of that spectrum.

Perhaps this is because many of us don't care about the rankings all the much; they haven't meant anything, so why bother? Of course, in light of Gines' proposals, we'll see if things change.

When you are anvil, be patient; when a hammer, strike.

Messages.Author: TorranceCircle
Messages.Body:
Aaron, I was just looking at this too. I was going to point this fact out also. If I am ranked based on the reported tournaments, and you are not, there must be some glitch as to why you rating is not there. I mean, I don't mind being ranked number 24 in the U.S. and number 463 in THE WORLD!!!

Gines, I am wondering if this can be looked at because I am one who likes these rankings. I don't care that one can be in an area with many tournaments and get a higher rating for being in them. I think some incentives for rankings are good. My incentive is I like to tell people who don't play that I am ranked. But, its kind of like when I tell people I once placed first in a Settlers of Caatan tournament. And then tell them I won first place in the cancelation round. If Aaron or Bill Troxel or anyone else is omitted because of some glitch, then I can say I am 463 in the world.......but then have to add the caveat that guys like Aaron and Bill aren't on the rankings.

-Andy

Messages.Author: Beatrice
Messages.Body: The (*) marks the events that are used in calculating player's current rating points. Only the 8 that give the most rating points are used.
